title: Meaning and Nonexistence of an Exact Three-Dimensional Ising Formula
exact_target: Define what an exact three-dimensional Ising solution would mean, then establish or refute an impossibility theorem.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 7800006 (AMR-077-0006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Andrew Lenard, original contribution to Open Problems in Mathematical Physics (1998), edited by Michael Aizenman.

status_qualification: The source requires both a definition and a proof or disproof. Choosing an arbitrarily narrow class of expressions does not settle the intended programme; no universal meaning of exact formula is imposed here.
